items.q: But, I was very fond of Billie. I knew her through the years.

ctx.x: for? A full rehearsal? That means hours, you know. The full rehearsal, I talked to Roy. I said, Who's the full rehearsal for? Do you know Babe Matthews? I said, No, I don't. Well, Billie Holiday had been there and Billie was accustomed to working with a smaller clubs. She was beautiful, beautiful voice and all that kind of thing but she's accustomed to smaller rooms. And they put her in a big room and she was, you know. But, I was very fond of Billie. I knew her through the years. And, so to follow her was Babe…
